Type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) is a major chronic disorder and a significant risk factor for AF, contributing to high morbidity and mortality. Metformin monotherapy can contribute to the reduced occurrence of adverse cardiovascular outcomes in patients with T2DM, but its effects on AF are understudied.
